name: community_warmth
note: P(problem community X cites paper i within 3 years | not citing it yet), ranked within a paper. Leave-one-cutoff-out: mean within-paper AUC 0.814, hit@3 0.686, MRR 0.570 (experiment 10).

feature_definitions.lcoup: log1p(100 * shared references between i and X's papers / size of X)
feature_definitions.prob_sim: cosine(i innovation, X's mean problem vector), 256-d
feature_definitions.lim_sim3_f: mean of the 3 highest cosines(i innovation, X's non-generic limitations), else prob_sim
feature_definitions.sim_recent: max cosine(i innovation, method/innovation of X's papers from the last 3 years)
